What they did

The agent finds leads and personalizes the first outreach, so the sales team can spend its time on high-value conversations and strategic accounts. The startup reportedly books 40+ meetings a month. Anthropic's page also cites a 72% cut in time-to-qualified-lead for Lindy sales teams generally. The page gives no details on conversion or lead quality.

Copy prompt
Build an agent that finds leads matching [ideal customer profile: role, company size, industry] from [source such as a LinkedIn export or a lead sheet]. For each lead, research their company and write a short personalized first email that mentions [product value in one line]. Save the drafts in [Google Sheet or email drafts] for my approval and do not send anything until I approve it.
